meta.name: Classical · all ℓp norms
meta.regime: Exact SVP on arbitrary rational full-rank lattices; Every fixed ℓp norm, 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞
meta.rules: Compare exact SVP in the specified norm regime. The norm is part of the problem, not a change of units. Polynomial input-size factors are suppressed; record space and success separately. Source-checked means the stated source claim was checked, not that the proof was independently verified.
